subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw trust and adopt these 14 new immutable action revisions in privileged security, publishing, token, container, and Codex-agent workflows?
rationale: The patch is mechanically clean, but accepting new third-party executable revisions with access to secrets and repository authority is an explicit maintainer trust decision that automated checks cannot make.

options.title: Approve verified revisions
options.body: Accept the batch after direct upstream review, the required sibling Codex inspection, a current-main refresh, and green exact-head checks.

options.title: Split privileged updates
options.body: Land routine setup actions separately while holding token, Codex, CodeQL, Docker publishing, and Blacksmith revisions for focused review.

options.title: Retain current pins
options.body: Pause or close the batch if any upstream revision or changed runtime contract cannot be verified confidently.

recommendation.title: Approve verified revisions
recommendation.body: Accept the batch after direct upstream review, the required sibling Codex inspection, a current-main refresh, and green exact-head checks.
